newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary maize futures rise broken.
newsitem.headline: Hungary maize futures rise broken.

text.p: Maize futures prices began a downward correction on Tuesday on the Budapest Commodity Exchange after two weeks of rises, traders said.
"The market seems to disagree with current high prices," said Istvan Markus of Swap Broker.
Maize futures prices dropped for December 1996, May, July and December 1997 by 150 to 260 forints, with maize accounting for 662 lots of the total 1,326 lots below-average turnover.
Milling wheat prices rose for most maturities but dropped for January and May 1997 by 200 and 400 forints respectively.
Feed wheat prices closed mixed after some speculative deals, Markus said.
Barley prices remained steady for most maturities, except for a rise in March, July and September 1997 prices by 200 to 500 forints on what Markus attributed to traders closing positions.
Lot size for all grain futures is 20,000 kgs.
